Hello, I’m

Tamarin Powell

Phytomedicinal Scientist

I spec­ialise in the extraction, molecular charac­teris­ation and profiling of medicinal plants, and I am working toward product devel­opment in the phyto­medicinal industry.

Get in touch LinkedIn
About

From medicinal plant to product.

My PhD at Stellenbosch University uses LC-MS metab­olomics and bioassay-guided isolation to find anti­microbial compounds in Aloe ferox, Salvia aurea and Tulbaghia violacea. Alongside the lab, I bring more than five years of lecturing, teaching and project-manage­ment experience. I have taken on many leadership roles and I enjoy working with people. I speak three languages: English, Afrikaans and French.

Theses & degrees

Academic background

From zoology and entomology to veterinary phytomedicine and botany.

Doctoral thesis · in progress

PhD Botany

Stellenbosch University · 2024 – 2026

An inter­disciplinary PhD investigating southern African medicinal plants as sources of novel anti­microbial compounds for natural drug devel­opment. LC–MS metabolomics, molecular networking and chemo­metrics compare extracts across species, plant parts and processing conditions to prioritise metabolites linked to anti­microbial activity. Active extracts then move through TLC-bio­autography, bioassay-guided fraction­ation, LC–MS/MS identi­fication and structural charac­terisation.

The aim is a metabolomics-guided workflow that de­convolutes complex plant extracts into bioactive metabolites, combinations and defined chemical leads for anti­microbial drug discovery and standard­isation.

Aloe feroxSalvia aureaTulbaghia violacea
  1. 1
    Extraction and fractionationOptimised across drying methods, solvents and plant parts (TLC, HPLC)
  2. 2
    Bioautography and antimicrobial MIC screeningAgar-overlay and spray methods
  3. 3
    Synergistic interactionsIsobolograms and checkerboard ratio methods
  4. 4
    UPLC-MS and LC-MS metabolomic profilingIncluding classic elemental-composition and chromatogram analysis
  5. 5
    Isolation by preparative TLC (prep-TLC)Solvent-system optimisation and repeated runs to confirm Rf values
  6. 6
    Structural elucidationNMR and LC-MS/MS
